H2214 user-requested insecure-by-default TLS peer verification: attacker-controlled active endpoints can impersonate server and obtain protected admission credentials; opt in tls-verify-server=true to authenticate server. This intentionally reverses H2213 default.

H2216: Native DATA/ACK accepts any received TTL 1..255 independent of sender persona, still checks IPv4/TCP checksums, trusted tuple, MTU and downstream AEAD/replay. Original Go parser has no received-TTL persona check. Physical Windows128→116/Linux64→52 captures are historical failure evidence, not post-fix physical WAN qualification; external physical WAN still NOT_RUN.
